newsitem.title: USA: Paper Brent extends recovery in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: Paper Brent extends recovery in late U.S. trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent extended a recovery in late U.S. paper trading on Monday, with both April and May cargoes changing hands, traders said.
A series of partial April Brents were dealt at $19.01 and $19.02 a barrel, compared to $18.92 at the IPE settlement in London.
April Brent rounded out the IPE in positive territory after gaining more than 15 cents in the last quarter hour of trade on the back of a NYMEX-led push, traders said.
A full boat of May Brent traded at $18.74 a barrel, up 10 cents from the IPE settlement of $18.64.
A partial May Brent moved at 18.78, up 14 cents from the London close.
April/May Brent traded at plus 28 cents, up two cents from a transaction earlier in the day.
March/April was talked at 24-26 cents, down from 25-30 cents in the afternoon.
